title: Third parties: vendors outside the town

calledBy.description: Our systems that call this vendor. Its health is read from the errors and latency of those calls.

slaP99Ms.description: How slow the vendor may get before it counts as degraded.

domains.description: Host names (and everything under them) that belong to this vendor, so link discovery recognises a call to one as a vendor call instead of reporting it as unresolved.
